properties.notes: Route 'will begin at Al-Khafji in the Eastern Province near Kuwait's border' (S-cp2-607, 12 May 2026). No station or crossing site published. Town centroid = OSM Al Khafji city node (67,012 pop. in OSM). Band = max(own built-up radius 5.19 km, geodesic 13.11 km to the named customs node 1237828458) (A-stn-001, A-stn-003). The old proxy (customs node) lies inside the band. Layer committed, design stage (S-032). [CP2_PREP research: S-cp2-607, S-032, S-cp2-601, S-cp2-602]

Dammam remains 'not confirmed' (C-008). The line passes through Dammam (S-cp2-607) but no station site is published. Band from the Dammam-Khobar built-up cluster (diameter 27.5 km, radius 13.76 km). OSM 'Dammam Railway Station' node/492547630 (SAR, existing) is 3.7 km away and inside the band; not used: no source links it to the GCC line. [CP2_PREP research: S-cp2-607, S-032, S-cp2-601, S-cp2-602]

Route 'will then extend southward to Al-Batha on the UAE border' (S-cp2-607). No crossing or station site published. OSM Al Batha node is a village-class place (crossing name). Band = built-up radius 1.26 km (374 buildings). Old proxy coordinates are the same node. [CP2_PREP research: S-cp2-607, S-032, S-cp2-601, S-cp2-602]
